name: @inneranimalmedia/ecommerce-cms-agentsam
description: Installable AgentSam ecommerce and website CMS application with product and inventory management, theme editing, media, analytics, and provider integrations.

scripts.build: npm run verify:cms && npm run build:frontend && npm run build:assets
scripts.verify:cms: npm run check:theme-contract && npm run typecheck:cms && node --test tests/theme-portable-ssot.test.mjs tests/theme-editor-entry.test.mjs backend/cms/site-inventory-readonly.test.mjs backend/cms/theme-project-listing-readonly.test.mjs tests/cms-setting-contract.test.mjs tests/portable-button-block.test.mjs tests/cms-definition-registry-portability.test.mjs backend/cms/theme-route-patterns.test.mjs && node --experimental-strip-types --test tests/cms-site-first-migration.test.mjs tests/cms-sites.test.mjs tests/cms-site-api.test.mjs tests/cms-theme-site-scope.test.mjs tests/cms-canonical-page-inventory.test.mjs tests/contracts/cms-data-family.test.mjs tests/contracts/cms-artifacts-block-system.test.mjs tests/generated-block-repository.test.mjs backend/cms/theme-project-store.test.mjs tests/cms-site-page-identity.test.mjs tests/cms-site-owned-page-compat.test.mjs tests/page-editor-host-navigation.test.mjs tests/cms-seo.test.mjs tests/cms-site-owned-r2.test.mjs tests/store-preferences-site-scope.test.mjs tests/home-site-firstpaint.test.mjs tests/theme-settings-roundtrip.test.mjs tests/cms-collections-alignment.test.mjs
scripts.test:tools: npm run typecheck:tools && node --test tests/typed-tool-registry.test.mjs tests/core-tools-readonly.test.mjs tests/d1-crud.test.mjs && node backend/tools/doctor.mjs
scripts.prepack: npm run build && npm run test:release
scripts.release:verify: npm run build && npm run test:package && npm run test:release
